title: DoupBotConfigFile
description: Configuration to bootstrap the doup dependency updater bot. (doupbot.{json,yaml})

authHttps.description: Basic credentials for an HTTPS origin.

user.description: The username to use with a HTTPS origin

pass.description: The password to use with a HTTPS origin

authSshKey.description: A private key, given directly, for an SSH origin.

key.description: The private key, in OpenSSH format, to use with an SSH origin. IMPORTANT: Must not be protected by a passphrase.
key.pattern: ^-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]+-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\s*$

authSshKeyPath.description: A private key, given as a path to a file, for an SSH origin.

key_path.description: A path to a private key file, in OpenSSH format, to use with an SSH origin. IMPORTANT: Must not be protected by a passphrase.

repos.description: A list of git repositories to update.

origin.description: The git origin URL (https or ssh accepted). If no authentication details are given, doup assumes git is already configured correctly.

auth.description: The authentication strategy to use against the origin.
